svg.title: A Terraform server module creates every server on Hetzner Cloud with its own firewall, a primary IP and a private network attachment. Internal services and each client project are separate stacks. A new server then goes through one Jenkins pipeline with Ansible: the inventory is built at run time, secrets come from Ansible Vault, each part is switched on or off for the run, and the server reaches the same baseline as the rest.
svg.text: each part on or off per run
hardening: SSH, audit, file integrity, AppArmor
users: a simple form in Jenkins
